moves.text: I welcome Douglas as counsel, then reverse the premise: his authorship can explain influence, not authorize reuse. I ask him to present a license, discover he cannot, and let the room separate admiration, historical attribution, estate permission, and professional legal review without pretending the joke cleared anything.

I let each request become more absurd: first creative advice, then proof of authority, then compensation terms, then a signed clearance. Douglas’s appointment collapses under its own paperwork while the scene keeps the central distinction intact: an imagined presence may sharpen judgment but cannot grant rights.

I put the receipt.json on the rehearsal table as the scene’s stubborn prop. Borges reads only access_blocked; Agnolo counts one failed read, zero bytes, unknown cost, and no request ID. I refuse to describe the Space, then name repairing the authorized profile as the cheapest next test.

I have Leonardo ask Douglas, “Can you authorize this?” Then I leave the silence unfilled. No historical prestige, fictional consent, or clever explanation becomes clearance. After the pause, I say we can continue rehearsing the idea, but publication waits for documented permission and professional review.
